testcase.name: Scenario: Dismiss Docking Positions from the expanded Constrain title menu: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:81:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Dismiss Docking Positions from the expanded Constrain title menu ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with an active editable `Sketch1` in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full Sketch ribbon is visible ✔ And the Constrain additional command area is open ✔ When the user right-clicks the lower Constrain title ✔ Then the title context menu offers Ribbon Appearance, Show Panels, Customize User Commands, Undock Ribbon and Docking Positions ✔ And the Constrain additional command area remains open ✔ When the user opens Docking Positions ✔ Then Top is checked and Left and Right are available ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the Docking Positions submenu closes and the title context menu remains open ✔ And the Constrain additional command area remains open ✔ When the user presses Escape again ✔ Then the title context menu and Constrain additional command area close ✔ And the editable sketch remains active and unchanged
